pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rectangular patches with serrated, high-frequency pixel gradients at the edges; spatial area of individual patches decreases noticeably from the upper flank towards the posterior and lower ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological grid; junction nodes are predominantly tri-nodal intersections with consistent pixel width maintained throughout the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a short, dense vertical structure with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background along the cervical and cranial-dorsal ridge.
